title: Why did Netflix use NGINX and FreeBSD to build their own CDN? by Gleb Smirnoff
summary: Gleb Smirnoff explains why Netflix built its own CDN on FreeBSD and NGINX, and how Netflix and NGINX Inc. collaborate on the software. It is a conference talk about open-source choices for video delivery.
why: Cited in FreeBSD vs Linux debates as the source for why Netflix chose FreeBSD, with commenters reading the GPL as the main factor.

quote.text: From both of those sources I would say avoiding GPL was the primary consideration.
